title: Line modules descend along affine limits of spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $I$ be a small nonempty directed set, and let $(Z_i)_{i\in I}$ be an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with affine transition morphisms and limit $Z=\varprojlim_i Z_i$ with projections $q_i$. A space is quasi-compact if it admits a surjective etale chart from a quasi-compact scheme, and quasi-separated if its diagonal is quasi-compact, where a map is quasi-compact if its inverse image over every affine scheme test is quasi-compact. A morphism is affine if it is representable and its pullback to every affine scheme test has affine source. A line module on an algebraic space is an $\mathcal O$-module on its small etale site locally isomorphic to $\mathcal O$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. For a morphism $a:Z\to W$, write $a^*M=\mathcal O_Z\otimes_{a^{-1}\mathcal O_W}a^{-1}M$ using its canonical ringed etale topoi [lem-trf-space-enlarged-etale-ringed-site-model]; on schemes use the corresponding ordinary invertible module [lem-trf-scheme-zariski-etale-quasi-coherent-equivalence, def-sc-invertible-module]. For every line module $L$ on $Z$ there are an index $i\in I$ and a line module $L_i$ on $Z_i$ with an isomorphism $q_i^*L_i\cong L$.

source.place: Tag 0D2X (lemma-descend-invertible-modules), clause (2), with the hypotheses spelled out in lemma-descend-finite-presentation (Tag 07SK).

proof.text: Set $N=\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Z}(L,\mathcal O_Z)$. By [lem-pur-sheaf-line-evaluation-inverse-pair], $N$ is a line and evaluation $e:L\otimes N\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_Z$ is an isomorphism. Each of $L,N$ has local presentation $0\to\mathcal O\xrightarrow{\sim}L$ or $0\to\mathcal O\xrightarrow{\sim}N$, so is finitely presented. Apply the object clause of [lem-sfb-space-fp-module-limit-category] twice and choose a common upper bound of the two indices. Its pullback-preservation clause gives finitely presented modules $A_i,B_i$ on that common stage with $q_i^*A_i\cong L$ and $q_i^*B_i\cong N$. These models need not yet be lines.

source.place: Tag 0D2X (lemma-descend-invertible-modules), proof of (2), dual and simultaneous finite-presentation models

proof.text: Put $P_i=A_i\otimes B_i$. It is finitely presented: on a common etale refinement choose presentations with $n,m$ generators and $r,s$ relations for $A_i,B_i$. The $nm$ pure tensor generators have the $rm+ns$ relations obtained by tensoring each relation in the first factor with a generator of the second, and conversely; this presents $P_i$. Also $\mathcal O_{Z_i}$ has its one-generator, no-relation presentation. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor] to the canonical ringed etale topoi. It gives $q_i^*P_i\cong q_i^*A_i\otimes q_i^*B_i$: the comparison and inverse send $c\otimes(a\otimes b)$ to $(c\otimes a)\otimes(1\otimes b)$ and $(c\otimes a)\otimes(d\otimes b)$ to $cd\otimes(a\otimes b)$. Balancing gives mutually inverse maps on the local presheaf tensors, hence on their sheafifications [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]; the cited general ringed-topos theorem supplies the inverse-image part of this comparison. The same formula identifies $q_i^*\mathcal O_{Z_i}$ with $\mathcal O_Z$. Composing the tensor comparison, the two model isomorphisms and $e$ gives an isomorphism $\epsilon:q_i^*P_i\xrightarrow{\sim}q_i^*\mathcal O_{Z_i}$.

source.place: Tag 0D2X (lemma-descend-invertible-modules), proof of (2), finite presentation of the tensor and the pullback-tensor identification

proof.text: Apply the morphism clause of [lem-sfb-space-fp-module-limit-category] to $\epsilon$ and $\epsilon^{-1}$, and take a common later stage $j$. This gives $u_j:q_{ji}^*P_i\to\mathcal O_{Z_j}$ and $v_j:\mathcal O_{Z_j}\to q_{ji}^*P_i$ pulling back to those two maps. Their composites pull back to identities. Apply the eventual-equality clause to $v_ju_j$ and the identity, and to $u_jv_j$ and the identity. At a common later stage $k$ both equalities hold. Thus $u_k:q_{ki}^*P_i\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_{Z_k}$ has inverse $v_k$. Every use of continuity has finitely presented source and target, and all systems are tails of the given nonempty directed system.

source.place: Tag 0D2X (lemma-descend-invertible-modules), proof of (2), descent of the specified evaluation and inverse and their two equations

proof.text: Set $L_k=q_{ki}^*A_i$ and $N_k=q_{ki}^*B_i$. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor] to the canonical ringed etale topoi of $q_{ki}$, with the local formulas of step 2, identifies $L_k\otimes N_k$ with $q_{ki}^*P_i$, hence $u_k$ gives $L_k\otimes N_k\cong\mathcal O_{Z_k}$. Apply [lem-sfb-space-tensor-inverse-line] to obtain that $L_k$ is a line on $Z_k$. Finally the composition isomorphism of tensor pullback in [lem-sfb-space-fp-module-limit-category] gives $q_k^*L_k\cong q_i^*A_i\cong L$, as required.
